test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The reign of Akbar **__was the one glorious periods__** in Indian history.

options.text: was one of the glorious periods
were one of the glorious period
was one of the glorious period

solution:
The correct answer is **"was one of the glorious periods."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect as it should be "one of the glorious periods"</str
